note: J10 gold ratings (docs/next-step-plan.md P1-J10, section 8). Agent-made, not the owner's own ratings: the judge is calibrated to an agent's taste guided by docs/taste-bar.md and a look at 99 pins from the owner's two boards. Re-checked from the 2026-10-15 and 2026-10-15b agent ratings by looking at every image; `was` holds the old rating where the re-check changed it. Directions are rated 1 to 5 (relevance 4 or 5 is on brief); references are great, good or bad by the taste bar rule. Images are hotlinked URLs only.

rules.relevance: Does the idea fit this brief's page and market? 4 or 5 counts as on brief.
rules.coherence: Do the ingredients, the mechanic and the page belong together?
rules.wow: Would a designer stop scrolling for it?
rules.great: Could sit on the owner's boards and is on the brief's page (UI) or idea (art).
rules.good: On page or on idea but generic.
rules.bad: Off page, off idea, a kit, clip art or below the bar.
rules.tiltedComps: Several tilted concept phones in a row cap at good, however polished.

directions.title: Mashrabiya screens in limestone
directions.reason: Limestone tabs could switch destinations, but stone on tabs is decoration and the film frames twist is unrelated.

directions.title: Exhibition catalog
directions.reason: Catalog header and a deck of plan cards hang together and suit comparing plans; not yet a surprise.

directions.title: Web brutalism 2015 revival
directions.reason: Raw web brutalism with ruler ticks could make a striking GB and days slider over the pick, compare, buy steps.

directions.title: Giant stripes
directions.reason: Stripes as section dividers on a checkout are safe and add no idea.

directions.title: Cairo cinema posters 1950s
directions.reason: Cairo cinema posters give the itinerary a loud voice, but Egyptian cinema misses a Gulf brief.

directions.title: One giant number
directions.reason: One giant number suits a checkout total, but the mechanic puts it on section tabs, where it reads oddly.

directions.title: Frutiger Aero 2007 revival
directions.reason: Frutiger Aero and Talavera tiles pull in two directions on one coffee page.

directions.title: Giant buttons
directions.reason: Giant buttons on a coffee landing page is a weak idea; one bigger button is not a direction.

directions.title: Papier-mache Korean hanji paper
directions.reason: Hanji papier-mache with screen sized ampersands is a fresh coffee look, but the ice-cold mood muddles the material.

directions.title: Only one accent color
directions.reason: Only one accent color is a rule, not an idea, though it is the restraint the taste bar asks for.

directions.title: Iranian termeh
directions.reason: Termeh borders give onboarding a craft voice; fine but expected at wildness 1.

directions.title: Giant grid squares
directions.reason: It frames a total, but onboarding has no total.

directions.title: Swedish dala painting
directions.reason: Dala painting as the empty state art is a clear, warm idea that fits the page.

directions.title: 1980s hip hop flyers
directions.reason: Hip hop flyers in a fitness empty state are fun, but the corduroy and bureaucratic mood do not cohere.

directions.title: Postmodern 1985 dried leaves
directions.reason: Dried leaves on the main button and a 1985 era have no link to a fitness empty state.

directions.title: Giant speech bubbles
directions.reason: Speech bubbles frame a total, but an offers page has no total, and the bubble art is clip art.

directions.title: 1939 World's Fair revival

directions.title: Cross-stitch boxing poster
directions.reason: A cross-stitch boxing poster clashes with a Ramadan offers page.

directions.title: Japanese furoshiki
directions.reason: Furoshiki bands between pricing sections are tasteful but only decorate the page.

directions.title: All tweed
directions.reason: Tweed only on the main button is thin.

directions.title: Giant letterforms
directions.reason: Giant letterforms in the header suit a pricing page and the editorial type on the taste bar.

directions.title: 35mm slide mount
directions.reason: A progress bar on a listing page has no steps, and the stitches twist is unrelated.

directions.title: Tokyo 1964 Olympics revival
directions.reason: Tokyo 1964 graphics give a Dubai listing an editorial voice; Egyptian khayamiya is a region miss.

directions.title: All graph paper
directions.reason: Graph paper empty state art on a listing page that has no empty state.

directions.title: Cyberpunk 1982 revival
directions.reason: Neon cyberpunk for a kids reading home is a stretch, and the wax seals do not belong.

directions.title: Corduroy circus poster
directions.reason: A circus poster header with Ankara wax colours suits a kids home screen and has energy.

directions.title: Mid-century modern 1955 porcelain
directions.reason: Porcelain and giant paper clips do not connect to kids reading.

directions.title: Giant chevrons
directions.reason: Giant chevrons on a gov dashboard header add nothing.

directions.title: No rounded corners anywhere
directions.reason: No rounded corners is a rule, not an idea.

directions.title: All screen print ink
directions.reason: Screen print ink dividers on a stormy dashboard are a surface, not an idea.
